nd13623a77f.headline: Expect economic growth of 6.5-7 pc this fiscal; pick up in private investment: FICCI President
nd13623a77f.summary: FICCI President Harsha Vardhan Agarwal expects GDP growth of 6.5-7% for the current financial year despite a weak second quarter. He also anticipates a pickup in private investment.
nd13623a77f.why: India is one of the world's fastest-growing large economies, so forecasts for its GDP and private investment shape expectations for Indian equities, the rupee and corporate earnings.

nafea5b287a.headline: Armenia government approves ratification of agreement with Hong Kong on income double taxation exclusion
nafea5b287a.summary: The Armenian government approved ratification of an agreement with Hong Kong on excluding income double taxation. The agreement was signed on June 24 in Yerevan.
nafea5b287a.why: Double taxation treaties set how cross-border income is taxed, affecting investment flows and the tax position of companies operating between the two jurisdictions.

n9e25227395.headline: Uzbekistan’s Debt to Russia Climbs Amid Rising Regional Loans
n9e25227395.summary: Russia's foreign lending surged to over $30 billion in 2023, the highest since 1999. Egypt, Bangladesh and India received the largest new loans.
n9e25227395.why: Sovereign lending between countries affects public debt levels and creditor exposure, which matter for emerging-market bonds and currencies.

n5e1983d54c.headline: G20 Africa Expert Panel to support Finance Track
n5e1983d54c.summary: Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana said a G20 Africa Expert Panel will be established to support the work of the G20 Finance Track.
n5e1983d54c.why: The G20 Finance Track coordinates economic policy among major economies, and its agenda influences global debt, development finance and fiscal policy.

nb2bc5dcdff.headline: Fiscal consolidation in Ghana, others to gain renewed focus next year – Fitch Solutions
nb2bc5dcdff.summary: Fitch Solutions says fiscal consolidation in Sub-Saharan Africa, including Ghana, will gain renewed focus in 2025. It says progress will be constrained by structural challenges.
nb2bc5dcdff.why: Fitch Solutions is the research arm of the rating agency Fitch, and its macro outlooks inform investor views on sovereign risk in frontier markets.

nfeb95efc72.headline: Tether on track to expand to 140B tokens after minting another billion USDT
nfeb95efc72.summary: Tether minted 21 billion new USDT since November 6, a flow that has coincided with Bitcoin rising to $100,000 and above. The new tokens are flowing into exchanges through market makers.
nfeb95efc72.why: Tether issues USDT, one of the largest stablecoins, and changes in its supply are watched as a gauge of liquidity entering crypto markets.

n5dbe386a92.headline: US says $365 million is available to install solar and battery storage systems in Puerto Rico
n5dbe386a92.summary: The US Department of Energy said $365 million is available to install solar and battery storage in homes and healthcare centres in Puerto Rico. Up to $190 million is for Puerto Rico's Housing Administration and a private company.
n5dbe386a92.why: Federal energy funding shapes investment in renewable and storage projects, and Puerto Rico's power grid has been a long-running policy focus.

ne847212935.headline: Creactives places 630,000 shares through accelerated bookbuilding
ne847212935.summary: Creactives Group placed 630,000 ordinary shares for EUR1.6 million through an accelerated bookbuilding reserved for institutional investors.
ne847212935.why: Accelerated bookbuilds are fast share sales to institutional investors, often used by small listed companies to raise capital quickly.

nde3ec07199.headline: Financial injustice a hindrance to Africa’s development
nde3ec07199.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres said transforming global financial institutions is critical to addressing Africa's mounting debt challenges. He described current arrangements as financial injustice.
nde3ec07199.why: Sovereign debt terms set by global lenders affect borrowing costs and fiscal room for African economies, which matters for investors in African bonds and infrastructure.

n03d6c307a4.headline: FNB Namibia issues first Basel III compliant notes
n03d6c307a4.summary: FNB Namibia issued N$500 million of Tier 2 capital notes under its domestic medium-term note programme, listed on the Namibian Stock Exchange. RMB acted as arranger.
n03d6c307a4.why: Tier 2 capital notes are subordinated debt that help banks meet regulatory capital requirements under the Basel III framework.

ndb350a7791.headline: November retail inflation cools down to 5.4% as vegetable prices ease, falls within RBI's tolerance limit  - BusinessToday
ndb350a7791.summary: India's retail inflation cooled to 5.4% in November as vegetable prices eased, bringing it back within the RBI's 2% to 6% tolerance band. October inflation had reached a 14-month high of 6.21%.
ndb350a7791.why: Retail inflation guides the Reserve Bank of India's interest rate decisions, which affect bond yields, borrowing costs and the rupee.

n37852ac652.headline: Repare Therapeutics :  Announces Positive Results of the Lunresertib and Camonsertib Combination from the MYTHIC Phase 1 Gynecologic Expansion Clinical Trial Form 8 K
n37852ac652.summary: Repare Therapeutics reported positive results for its lunresertib and camonsertib combination from the MYTHIC Phase 1 gynecologic expansion trial, in heavily pretreated patients.
n37852ac652.why: Repare is a clinical-stage cancer drug developer, and trial results shape its pipeline value and future partnering or regulatory prospects.

nde30df4721.headline: HDFC Bank gets warning letter from SEBI over alleged regulatory non compliance  - BusinessToday
nde30df4721.summary: India's market regulator SEBI issued a warning letter to HDFC Bank over alleged regulatory non-compliance. The bank said it will address the concerns and that the letter has no quantifiable financial or operational impact.
nde30df4721.why: HDFC Bank is one of India's largest private-sector lenders, and regulatory actions by SEBI can affect investor sentiment toward listed Indian financial companies.

nea5eaa0647.headline: IMF open to renegotiating Ghana's $3 billion financing program if reforms aren't derailed
nea5eaa0647.summary: The IMF is open to renegotiating Ghana's $3 billion financing program with the incoming administration, provided accompanying reforms are not jeopardised. A spokesperson said changes would be developed with national authorities.
nea5eaa0647.why: The International Monetary Fund provides balance-of-payments financing and policy conditions to member countries, shaping sovereign debt and fiscal outlooks.

n5e5d2759e1.headline: The WhatsApp Effect: How SMS Costs Fell from 9 Cents to 0.26 Cents in Zimbabwe. What of Voice Though?
n5e5d2759e1.summary: Messaging costs in Zimbabwe have fallen from 9 cents per SMS to 0.26 cents, according to a Techzim analysis of WhatsApp's impact. The report also asks what this means for voice services.
n5e5d2759e1.why: Messaging apps such as WhatsApp, owned by Meta, have displaced SMS and reshaped telecom revenue in many markets.

ndc19eadb29.headline: Australia Mandates News Payments From Meta And Google: How Will It Affect The Public?
ndc19eadb29.summary: Australia has mandated news payments from Meta and Google. News Corp Australasia's executive chair Michael Miller said the incentive would help the industry recover from an estimated 1,000 job losses this year.
ndc19eadb29.why: Meta and Alphabet are large digital advertising platforms, and payment mandates affect their revenue and publisher relationships.

n13219da2b5.headline: NGX investors gain N152bn as capitalisation nears N60tn
n13219da2b5.summary: The Nigerian Exchange recorded a bullish trading session on Thursday, with market capitalisation rising to N59.9tn. Investors gained N152bn in value.
n13219da2b5.why: The Nigerian Exchange is Nigeria's main stock market, and its capitalisation reflects investor sentiment across listed Nigerian companies.

n04a605ffbd.headline: Irish inflation picks up to 1.0% in November but prices down on month
n04a605ffbd.summary: Irish inflation sped up on an annual basis in November, though prices declined from October, according to Central Statistics Office data published Thursday. The consumer price index rose on the year.
n04a605ffbd.why: Consumer inflation data shapes expectations for interest rates and the European Central Bank's policy path, affecting euro-area bonds and banks.

nc17b7e5165.headline: US solar industry downplays climate in strategy for Trump era
nc17b7e5165.summary: The US solar industry unveiled its lobbying strategy for the incoming Trump administration, promoting itself as a domestic jobs engine that can meet soaring power demand. The strategy does not reference climate change.
nc17b7e5165.why: Policy support for solar affects project economics, equipment demand and the financing of renewable energy developers.

n7b2775f5d2.headline: UN chief calls for reform of global financial institutions
n7b2775f5d2.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for the reform of global financial institutions. He made the call in Johannesburg, according to the report.
n7b2775f5d2.why: Global financial institutions such as the IMF and World Bank set lending rules and shape how developing economies access capital. Reform proposals influence sovereign borrowing conditions and global policy direction.

n4180006939.headline: Woodside gas project given WA environmental approval
n4180006939.summary: A large Woodside gas project received Western Australian environmental approval after six years of assessment and hundreds of appeals against it.
n4180006939.why: Woodside is Australia's largest independent oil and gas producer, and its LNG projects supply key Asian energy markets.

n7376ded731.headline: IMF open to renegotiating Ghana's $3bn deal with Mahama's administration
n7376ded731.summary: The IMF said it is open to renegotiating Ghana's $3 billion financing programme with the Mahama administration, provided accompanying reforms are not jeopardised.
n7376ded731.why: The IMF lends to member countries under programmes tied to economic reforms, and terms shape a country's fiscal path and investor confidence.

n2ec3465a3b.headline: CAAV set to step up its estimates of numbers to be hit by IHT
n2ec3465a3b.summary: The Central Association of Agricultural Valuers has published analysis showing that even more farmers will be affected by the government's planned inheritance tax changes.
n2ec3465a3b.why: Changes to inheritance tax on agricultural land affect farm succession, land values and the financial planning of UK agricultural businesses.

ne369ab2442.headline: Ghana’s economy surpasses expectations with 6.3% growth in 2024 – MoF
ne369ab2442.summary: Ghana's Ministry of Finance said the economy grew 6.3% in 2024 and continues to outperform expectations. The ministry cited the country's dynamism despite global and domestic challenges.
ne369ab2442.why: Ghana's growth and fiscal performance shape sovereign credit assessments and investor sentiment toward frontier African markets.

ne7cec95c9f.headline: Australia to force tech titans to pay for news
ne7cec95c9f.summary: Australia will force Meta and Google to pay for news shared on their platforms under a new scheme. The government threatens to tax the companies if they refuse.
ne7cec95c9f.why: Meta and Google are the largest digital advertising platforms, and payment rules for news content directly affect their revenue and regulatory exposure.

n62c07cd5b2.headline: Union Budget 2025: Fiscal glide path meaning, importance explained
n62c07cd5b2.summary: India faces challenges in meeting its 4.5% fiscal deficit target for 2025-26, due to economic slowdowns and pandemic-induced disruptions, according to the article.
n62c07cd5b2.why: India's Union Budget sets government spending and borrowing plans, which shape its bond yields, currency and growth outlook. The fiscal deficit target is a key anchor for investors in Indian sovereign debt.

n0473f4e310.headline: Argentina poultry production rises to meet demand
n0473f4e310.summary: Argentina's poultry slaughter capacity should allow production to rise by up to 10% to meet demand, according to the report.
n0473f4e310.why: Poultry is a meaningful part of Argentina's agricultural and food export sector, and production changes affect feed demand and food supply.

n78ed2da802.headline: Test article for SEO Compliance - Times of India
n78ed2da802.summary: Insignia Financial held A$319.6 billion in funds under management at the end of September. Neither Insignia nor Bain Capital responded to requests for comment.
n78ed2da802.why: Insignia Financial is an Australian wealth and asset manager, and Bain Capital is a large private equity firm with a deal interest in the company.

n2eeda97036.headline: FG issues N1tn sukuk bond to fund 124 road projects
n2eeda97036.summary: The Federal Government of Nigeria issued six sovereign sukuk bonds worth N1.1 trillion, about $657.6 million. The proceeds will finance 124 federal road projects.
n2eeda97036.why: Sovereign sukuk are Shariah-compliant government bonds, and Nigeria uses such issuance to fund infrastructure and broaden its investor base.

n4dbcc7eec2.headline: Australia tech giants: Australia asks tech giants to share revenue with local media outlets or cough up taxes
n4dbcc7eec2.summary: The Australian government plans to tax large tech companies such as Meta and Google if they do not compensate local news outlets for content. The measure is due to take effect on January 1.
n4dbcc7eec2.why: Meta and Google are major digital advertising platforms, and new levies or content-payment rules can affect their revenue and regulatory exposure in Australia.

n6d88a02ba9.headline: Bajaj Housing Finance shares plunged 6%; what's next for this HFC stock? - BusinessToday
n6d88a02ba9.summary: Bajaj Housing Finance, a non-deposit-taking housing finance company registered with the National Housing Bank, saw its shares plunge 6%. Promoters held 88.75% as of September 2024.
n6d88a02ba9.why: Bajaj Housing Finance is a large Indian housing lender, and its shares reflect the outlook for India's mortgage and real estate financing market.
n6d88a02ba9.why_moved: The input reports a 6% share price drop but does not state a cause.

n29be22686f.headline: Dutton's plan has coal-fired power stations operating for a lot longer
n29be22686f.summary: The Australian opposition has put in place the last piece of its nuclear policy. The plan would keep coal-fired power stations operating for a longer period.
n29be22686f.why: Coal-fired power plants are a major source of Australia's electricity, and energy policy shapes utility, mining and emissions-related investment. Nuclear and coal policies affect long-term energy supply.

n5f942e8e97.headline: North American Morning Briefing :  Inflation Fears Damp Mood as Hopes of Aggressive Fed Cuts Fade
n5f942e8e97.summary: Stock futures dipped and Treasury yields continued to rise as investors weighed whether the Federal Reserve can make many interest-rate cuts. Inflation fears dampened sentiment.
n5f942e8e97.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and expectations for its policy path drive equity valuations and bond yields worldwide.
n5f942e8e97.why_moved: Investors grew concerned the Federal Reserve may not be able to make many rate cuts because of inflation fears, weighing on equity futures and lifting Treasury yields.

n1a5836660a.headline: Dutton's plan has coal-fired power stations operating for a lot longer
n1a5836660a.summary: The opposition has put in place the last piece of its nuclear policy, which would see coal-fired power stations operating for a longer period. Details are limited in the summary.
n1a5836660a.why: Australia's electricity policy shapes long-term energy supply, power prices and investment in coal, gas and renewables.

nd87ea79d51.headline: Sensex  falls! These  stocks fell 5% or more in Thursday
nd87ea79d51.summary: Indian benchmark indexes fell on Thursday, with 34 Nifty stocks closing in the red and 16 in the green. Several stocks fell 5% or more over the session.
nd87ea79d51.why: The BSE Sensex is India's benchmark equity index, tracking the country's largest listed companies and gauging investor sentiment in the Indian market.
nd87ea79d51.why_moved: Most Nifty constituents ended lower, with 34 stocks in the red against 16 in the green, and several stocks falling 5% or more.

n152b46655e.headline: London house prices to see resurgence in 2025
n152b46655e.summary: Rightmove predicts 2025 will be a turning point for London house prices, aided by companies returning to the office full-time. London asking prices are 12% higher than five years ago.
n152b46655e.why: House prices affect mortgage lending, household wealth and construction activity, which feed into the UK economy and banks' loan books.

nfbb245ba69.headline: Retailers urge FM and GST Council not to go for higher 35 pc tax rate
nfbb245ba69.summary: Indian Sellers Collective has urged the finance minister and GST Council not to accept proposals including a higher 35 per cent tax rate. The group represents trade associations and sellers nationwide.
nfbb245ba69.why: The Goods and Services Tax sets indirect tax rates across India, and changes to rate slabs directly affect retail prices, consumer demand and seller margins.

na3a4514338.headline: 17 Education & Technology :  Announces Third Quarter 2024 Unaudited Financial Results Form 6 K
na3a4514338.summary: 17 Education & Technology Group released unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2024. The Beijing-based company is a education provider.
na3a4514338.why: 17 Education & Technology is a China-based education company. Quarterly results show the financial health of its operations and its outlook.

n7a8c30e8ea.headline: TNMP files Unopposed Settlement in System Resiliency Plan
n7a8c30e8ea.summary: TNMP, a wholly owned subsidiary of TXNM Energy, filed an unopposed settlement in its application with the Public Utility Commission regarding its system resiliency plan.
n7a8c30e8ea.why: Regulated utilities recover infrastructure spending through rates approved by state regulators, so settlements like this shape their allowed investment returns.

n3616f35a50.headline: Stock market today: Wall Street’s rally stalls as Nasdaq pulls back from its record
n3616f35a50.summary: US stock indexes fell Thursday after potentially discouraging economic data. The S&P 500 slipped 0.5%, its fourth loss in six days, pausing a rally that had reached records.
n3616f35a50.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite are the benchmark US equity indexes, so their daily moves reflect broad sentiment toward US companies and the economy.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index fell 0.5% after weaker economic data reduced risk appetite.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n3616f35a50.why_moved: Potentially discouraging economic data on Thursday weighed on US stocks, halting a rally and pulling the Nasdaq back from its record.

n0688438db6.headline: Gamuda records higher 1Q net profit of RM205.39mi, orderbook hits record-high of RM30bil
n0688438db6.summary: Gamuda reported first-quarter net profit of RM205.39 million and a record orderbook of RM30 billion, with growth expected from overseas and domestic construction, including data centres.
n0688438db6.why: Gamuda is a Malaysian construction and infrastructure company, so its orderbook and profit reflect the pipeline of public and private construction projects.

n38cc8d4e03.headline: Europe: Stocks settle lower after ECB trims interest rates as expected
n38cc8d4e03.summary: European stocks settled lower on Thursday after the European Central Bank cut rates by 25 basis points as expected. The bank left the door open for further easing to support a struggling economy.
n38cc8d4e03.why: The ECB sets monetary policy for the euro area, and its rate decisions shape borrowing costs, bond yields and the euro's value for investors across Europe.
n38cc8d4e03.why_moved: The 25 basis point cut was expected, while the signal of possible further easing weighed on European stocks, which settled lower.

n44a95b4178.headline: US hikes tariffs on imports of Chinese solar wafers, polysilicon and tungsten products
n44a95b4178.summary: US tariffs on Chinese-made solar wafers and polysilicon will rise to 50% from 25%, and duties on certain tungsten products will increase from zero to 25%, effective Jan. 1. The USTR issued the notice.
n44a95b4178.why: Tariffs on Chinese solar components and critical materials such as polysilicon affect the cost of solar panels and the supply chains of the clean energy industry.

n6838bb8a78.headline: Nepra likely to cut power tariff for KE consumers
n6838bb8a78.summary: Pakistan's power regulator Nepra is likely to cut the electricity tariff for K-Electric consumers. The relief could amount to Rs 460 million for Karachi customers.
n6838bb8a78.why: Electricity tariffs set by regulators affect household costs, utility revenues and inflation expectations in Pakistan. K-Electric is the main power distributor serving Karachi.

n4a3a872f90.headline: Singapore’s new family office framework raises compliance standards | Family Offices
n4a3a872f90.summary: Singapore has introduced tougher family office rules that tighten compliance to deter misuse while allowing more operational flexibility. The move follows the country's largest money-laundering case.
n4a3a872f90.why: Family offices manage wealth for wealthy families and are a growing segment of Singapore's asset management industry. Stricter oversight affects capital flows and compliance costs.

n99b3ef7b25.headline: China's Xi is likely to decline Trump's inauguration invitation, seeing it as too risky to attend
n99b3ef7b25.summary: China experts say Chinese leader Xi Jinping would likely see Donald Trump's inauguration invitation as too risky to accept. They add that the gesture may have little bearing on increasingly competitive China-US ties.
n99b3ef7b25.why: US-China relations shape trade, tariffs and investment flows that affect global markets and multinational supply chains.

na5d50f0f20.headline: Agnico Eagle to Acquire O3 Mining in Friendly Transaction
na5d50f0f20.summary: Agnico Eagle Mines and O3 Mining have agreed to a friendly transaction under which Agnico Eagle will acquire O3 Mining. Both companies are listed in Canada and the United States.
na5d50f0f20.why: Agnico Eagle is a Toronto-based gold miner with operations in several countries, and consolidation in gold mining affects reserves and valuations across the sector.

n198e0c2b18.headline: Political turmoil in Korea fuels market instability | Equities
n198e0c2b18.summary: Despite political uncertainty, institutional investors maintain a positive outlook on South Korea's equity market, citing attractive valuations. They expect the crisis to be short-lived.
n198e0c2b18.why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main equity benchmark, and political developments can influence foreign and institutional flows into local stocks.

n26e4d5cca4.headline: Trump’s Push to Eliminate EV Tax Credits Hits GOP Lawmakers’ Home States
n26e4d5cca4.summary: President-elect Donald Trump's vow to repeal electric vehicle subsidies risks pushing Republican congressional allies into conflict with their home-district economic interests. Bloomberg reports the EV tax credits affect those districts.
n26e4d5cca4.why: EV tax credits lower the cost of electric vehicles for buyers, so their repeal affects the automotive and battery supply chain.

n7d4686d619.headline: Topright Nordic subsidiary filed for bankruptcy, intends to appeal
n7d4686d619.summary: A Gothenburg district court declared Topright Sweden, a subsidiary of smart-tech company Topright Nordic, bankrupt. The reason is unpaid tax owed to the Swedish Tax Agency, and the company intends to appeal.
n7d4686d619.why: Topright Nordic is a Nordic smart-technology company. Bankruptcy of a subsidiary can signal financial stress at the group level for creditors and shareholders.

na1cbe644f2.headline: Morning bid:  ECB, Swiss set to cut, but by how much?
na1cbe644f2.summary: Policy decisions from the European Central Bank and the Swiss National Bank are due Thursday, with markets focused on how large the expected cuts will be.
na1cbe644f2.why: The ECB sets interest rates for the euro area, and the Swiss National Bank sets policy for Switzerland; their decisions shape borrowing costs, bond yields and currencies.

nf8c2b23714.headline: Tesla shares surge to record high after Donald Trump election win
nf8c2b23714.summary: Tesla shares rose to a record high following Donald Trump's election win. The electric vehicle maker's share price had come close to US$100 less than two years earlier.
nf8c2b23714.why: Tesla is the world's most valuable electric vehicle maker, and its share price is closely watched as a bellwether for the EV and growth-stock segment.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: The share price rose to a record high after the election result, per the headline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nf8c2b23714.why_moved: The headline links the share surge to Donald Trump's election win, a political event that markets read as favourable for certain sectors.

nb8ecc82d85.headline: Chinese Solar Stocks Shrug Off New U.S. Tariffs
nb8ecc82d85.summary: Chinese solar stocks largely shrugged off new US tariffs on imports of China-made solar wafers and polysilicon. Shares of Jinko Solar and others were cited in the report.
nb8ecc82d85.why: Polysilicon and wafers are key inputs in solar-cell manufacturing, and China dominates global supply, so US tariffs affect the cost and trade flows of the solar industry.

ne6de79e2c2.headline: Switzerland's SoftwareOne and Norway's Crayon are in talks to combine, sources say
ne6de79e2c2.summary: Swiss technology firm SoftwareOne Holding and Norwegian rival Crayon Group Holding are in talks to combine, two people familiar with the matter told Reuters. The talks are ongoing.
ne6de79e2c2.why: SoftwareOne is a Swiss software licensing and cloud reseller, and Crayon is a Norwegian peer, so a combination would reshape a consolidating software reseller market.

n40b62f1de3.headline: Exclusive-BOJ leaning toward keeping rates steady next week, sources say
n40b62f1de3.summary: The Bank of Japan is leaning toward keeping interest rates steady next week, as policymakers want more time to scrutinise overseas risks and wage outlook clues, sources said.
n40b62f1de3.why: The Bank of Japan sets the country's short-term interest rate, which influences the yen and Japanese government bond yields.

n2fc3f6c40b.headline: Trump invites China’s Xi to inauguration despite threat of tariffs on Beijing
n2fc3f6c40b.summary: Trump has invited China's Xi to his inauguration despite a threat of tariffs on Beijing. Every country's chief of mission to the United States will also be invited.
n2fc3f6c40b.why: US-China trade and tariff policy directly affects global supply chains, company earnings and bilateral market sentiment.

n78628335ee.headline: Why Your Morning Cup Of Coffee Might Be Getting Even Pricier
n78628335ee.summary: Coffee prices have been rising, and a Yahoo News report says they are expected to keep climbing.
n78628335ee.why: Coffee is traded as arabica futures on ICE in New York, and futures prices feed into the retail cost of coffee.

n634fe74817.headline: Quebec, Newfoundland and Labrador announce energy deal worth billions
n634fe74817.summary: Quebec and Newfoundland and Labrador have signed a sweeping new deal to build energy projects and end a decades-old contract that has been a source of dispute.
n634fe74817.why: Hydro-Québec is Quebec's state-owned utility, and large hydroelectric contracts shape long-term power supply and investment in eastern Canada.

nf0715fbdab.headline: Cardinal Energy Ltd. Announces Redetermination and Upsizing of Credit Facility
nf0715fbdab.summary: Cardinal Energy Ltd. has agreed with its syndicate of lenders to redetermine and increase its credit facilities.
nf0715fbdab.why: Credit facilities give oil and gas producers borrowing capacity, and redeterminations usually reflect updated reserve values.

n525bed3ee9.headline: Trump Trolls Trudeau – Bank Of Canada Takes Note
n525bed3ee9.summary: US-Canada relations are off to a tumultuous start, with Trump promising to impose 25% tariffs on all imports from Canada, according to the report.
n525bed3ee9.why: Canada and the United States are each other's largest trading partners, so tariffs on Canadian goods affect cross-border supply chains and exporters.
n525bed3ee9.why_moved: A threatened 25% tariff on all Canadian imports raises trade-cost expectations for Canadian exporters and cross-border supply chains.

n3dd4edd7bf.headline: Trump vows 'tremendous incentive' on taxes during NYSE visit
n3dd4edd7bf.summary: Ahead of ringing the New York Stock Exchange opening bell, President-elect Trump said the US would have an economy like none before and promised a tremendous tax incentive.
n3dd4edd7bf.why: The New York Stock Exchange is the largest equity exchange in the world, and US tax policy affects corporate earnings and investment decisions.

neffe420a93.headline: HDFC Bank: Mutual funds sold Rs 11,000 crore worth shares in Nov; what's ahead? - BusinessToday
neffe420a93.summary: Mutual funds used MSCI-driven liquidity at November-end to partially exit inclusion names such as HDFC Bank, according to Nuvama Alternative & Quantitative Research.
neffe420a93.why: HDFC Bank is one of India's largest private lenders, and mutual fund flows affect its share price and liquidity.

na12f6311de.headline: CBG Restarts Foreign Currency Trade
na12f6311de.summary: The Bank of Ghana restored the foreign currency trading licence of Consolidated Bank Ghana, effective December 4, 2024. The bank has resumed all foreign currency services at its branches after the licence was suspended in November 2024.
na12f6311de.why: The central bank licenses and supervises banks that trade foreign currency in Ghana. Licence suspensions and restorations affect FX liquidity and access for local businesses.
